summary: Iteration 2 tests next-action features for thoraHELP: PWA assets, i18n (EN/HI) switcher with localStorage persistence, signal history endpoint + page with role/status filters, BottomNav 4-item layout, Header history menu, and SMS fallback button on SignalDetail. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass (added 10 new tests for /api/signals/history, regression on /api/signals/{id} preserved). Frontend: all required data-testids present and flows pass end-to-end with real signup -> profile patch -> SOS create -> SMS href validation -> history listing.
critical_code_review_comments: SignalDetail.jsx buildSmsHref uses '?&body=' which works on iOS/Android but is slightly unusual; the leading '&' is harmless but you may simplify to '?body='.

Service worker registration is intentionally production-only (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'); in dev preview, /sw.js is served as a static file but never registered. This is by design but should be documented in README.

manifest.json references icon-192.png and icon-512.png but only icon.svg is present in /public; current install will fall back to svg, but raster icons are recommended for older Android. Non-blocking.
i18n: language switcher writes 'th_lang' to localStorage and reads on init — confirmed working. Consider also setting <html lang=...> attribute for accessibility (currently stays 'en').
History endpoint signals_history is correctly registered BEFORE /signals/{signal_id} in server.py; verified by literal-path test (no 422/404).
History page filter only re-queries when tab/status change; ensure no duplicate fetch on mount (visually OK in tests).
test_credentials: Admin admin@thorahelp.app / Admin@12345 OK. Fresh users via /api/auth/register (TEST_*, new_user_*, sms_user_*) all working.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_* users + a few signals (sig_*) created during tests; one resolved by user_a fixture, one active under sms_user_<ts> for SMS-href verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SOSButton testid is 'sos-button' (NOT 'sos-trigger-btn' which was wrongly assumed in review_request). After PATCH /api/auth/profile to set emergency_contact_phone, you MUST hard-navigate to /app (or refresh) for React AuthContext user state to reflect — calling /me on navigation hydrates the user object so SignalDetail receives updated emergency_contact_phone. SMS href format: sms:<phone>?&body=<urlencoded>; body contains 'https://maps.google.com/?q=<lat>,<lng>'. Hindi hero string 'एक टैप। पड़ोसी दौड़े चले आएंगे।' confirmed. localStorage key is 'th_lang'. Logout redirects to /login (not /).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Two test-script issues encountered during run (not app bugs): (1) used wrong testid 'sos-trigger-btn' first, corrected to 'sos-button'; (2) await-in-string template page.evaluate had syntax error in one branch — non-blocking, covered by other tests. Logout assertion expected redirect to '/' but the app redirects to '/login', which is the correct UX and verified visually.
